name: Northwind Traders (simulated company)

applications.name: Northwind Mail
applications.description: Shared accounts-payable inbox (already signed in). Vendor invoices arrive here, usually as PDF attachments. Supports search and composing/sending email.

applications.name: Northwind ERP
applications.description: Internal accounts-payable system: bills and vendors. Sign in as user 'agent.worker' with password {{secret:erp_password}}.

applications.name: Northwind ERP API
applications.description: JSON API for the same ERP. Send header X-API-Key: {{secret:erp_api_key}}. GET /vendors?q=, GET /bills?invoice_number=&vendor_id=, POST /bills with {vendor_id, invoice_number, invoice_date, due_date (ISO YYYY-MM-DD), currency, amount, category, notes}.

notes: A shared workspace folder holds reference files for the AP team; downloaded files are saved there under downloads/.
Company currency is USD; vendors may invoice in EUR or GBP - record bills in the invoice currency.
